import pandas as pd

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Adjust prices for splits
    adjusted_prices = prices * split_factors
    
    # Calculate daily returns
    daily_returns = adjusted_prices.pct_change().dropna()
    
    # Initialize weights DataFrame with zeros
    weights = pd.DataFrame(np.zeros_like(daily_returns), index=daily_returns.index, columns=daily_returns.columns)
    
    # Warmup period
    warmup_period = 21
    
    for t in range(warmup_period, len(daily_returns)):
        for asset in daily_returns.columns:
            # Calculate momentum signal
            momentum = np.sign(daily_returns.iloc[t-1, daily_returns.columns.get_loc(asset)] /

            # Calculate sample standard deviation of last 20 returns
            std_dev = daily_returns.iloc[t-20:t, daily_returns.columns.get_loc(asset)].std(ddof=1)
            
            # Calculate target exposure
            target_exposure = min(1, 0.10 / (std_dev * np.sqrt(252)))
            
            # Assign weight
            weights.iloc[t, daily_returns.columns.get_loc(asset)] = momentum * target_exposure / 4

    # Calculate rolling standard deviation of returns over the last 20 days
    rolling_std = daily_returns.rolling(window=20, min_periods=1).std(ddof=1)
    
    # Calculate the target momentum signal
    momentum_signal = np.sign(daily_returns.shift(-1) / daily_returns - 1)
    
    # Apply the volatility targeting factor
    volatility_factor = np.minimum(1, 0.10 / (rolling_std * np.sqrt(252)))
    
    # Calculate the final weights
    weights.iloc[warmup_period:] = momentum_signal.iloc[warmup_period:] * volatility_factor.iloc[warmup_period:] / 4
    
    return weights

    adjusted_prices = prices * split_factors
    
    # Initialize the weights DataFrame with zeros
    weights = pd.DataFrame(np.zeros_like(prices), index=prices.index, columns=prices.columns)

    std_devs = adjusted_prices.iloc[:-21].rolling(window=20, ddof=1).std()

    momentum = (adjusted_prices.shift(-1) / adjusted_prices.shift(21)) - 1
    
    # Apply the formula to calculate weights
    for col in prices.columns:
        mask = ~np.isnan(momentum[col]) & ~np.isinf(momentum[col])
        weights.loc[mask, col] = np.sign(momentum.loc[mask, col]) * \
                                  np.minimum(1, 0.10 / (std_devs.loc[mask, col] * np.sqrt(252))) / 4
    
    # Ensure weights are non-negative
    weights = weights.clip(lower=0)
    
    # Set weights to zero for the first 20 days
    weights.iloc[:20] = 0
    
    return weights
